# Herzlich Willkommen

Mitten in der historischen Altstadt von Basel erwartet Sie unser Restaurant – ein Ort, an dem klassische Eleganz und moderne Gastlichkeit aufeinandertreffen. Unsere Küche vereint gut bürgerliche Küche und mediterrane Speisen mit hochwertigen, saisonalen Zutaten aus der Region.

In stilvollem Ambiente servieren wir feine Gerichte, begleitet von einer sorgfältig kuratierten Weinauswahl und aufmerksamem Service. Ob zum Dinner oder für einen besonderen Anlass – wir schaffen Genussmomente, die bleiben.

![Aussen](/sites/default/files/styles/wide/public/page/aussen%202.jpeg.webp?itok=IZyoXKCQ)

[![Wine & Dine am 28. Oktober](/sites/default/files/event/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-09-25%20at%2015.05.30.jpeg)](/sites/default/files/event/Wine%20and%20Dine%2028.10.26.pdf)

### Wine & Dine

Mittwoch, 28.10.2026  
Die Azienda Agricola Villanoviana entsteht im Herzen des Bolgheri DOC,  
unweit des mittelalterlichen Dorfes Bolgheri und seiner berühmten  
Zypressenallee. Sie erstreckt sich über 6 Hektar Weinberge,  
die mit Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot,  
Vermentino und Viognier bepflanzt sind.  
Mit uns an diesem Abend wird der Gründer und Winzer, Herr Marco Belli,  
sein, der uns durch eine fantastische Degustation seiner Weine führen wird

axes.basis: measured: weighted mean hue 300° (warm), mean saturation 91% across 2 chromatic clusters; 5 neutral clusters.
axes.change: Swap the cool neutrals for warm cream and wood tones, keeping the wine magenta as the single warm accent.

axes.basis: measured: 3 font families (0 system defaults, most used: Roboto), 4 distinct radii, 11 distinct colours.
axes.change: Replace the generic Roboto and Google Sans stack with a refined serif display paired with a humanist sans for body text.
Add two soft shadow levels and a subtle warm gradient on cards so the menu and room panels feel layered.

axes.basis: reading of copy: hours, capacities and prices are stated plainly, while phrases like 'Genussmomente, die bleiben' add warmth.
axes.change: Keep the capacity and opening-hour facts prominent but lead each section with one sentence of atmosphere.

axes.basis: reading of copy: the site addresses guests with formal 'Sie' and a personal reservation note, with only the newsletter using 'du'.
axes.change: Keep the formal 'Sie' address and add a warmer personal sign-off from the host on the reservation block.

axes.basis: reading of copy: the copy is earnest and descriptive, with no humour; the food photography carries the mood.
axes.change: Introduce a light, witty tone in the event and newsletter blurbs while keeping the dining facts serious.

axes.basis: measured: 310 visible characters per 1000 px of page height (3187 chars over 10273 px), body text 10 px.
axes.change: Raise body text to 16 px and double the vertical spacing between sections so the page breathes like the plated dishes.

report.brief:
Signature idea: "Tor" as a doorway. Every section heading sits inside a tall arch-topped Anton block (border-radius: 50% 50% 0 0 / 30% 30% 0 0), like the old city gate. The hero photo uses the same arch mask, so the gate motif carries through the whole page.

Hero: A full-width var(--color-primary) block. "TORSTÜBLI" is set in Anton, clamp(6rem, 18vw, 16rem), and fills the width edge to edge. Image #2 (Aussen) sits in a tall arch-masked panel on the right third. It overlaps the block's bottom edge by 20vh into the bg. Below sit the heroSub and one filled CTA, left-aligned on surface. Under the hero, a marquee-style static strip of Öffnungszeiten runs as plain text on var(--color-surface), with a hairline top and bottom.

Sections:
- Reservationen: two columns, text left and phone right.
- Saisonale Hits: full-bleed #3 left at 7/12, text right.
- Räume: four parallel cards for Garten, Reblaube, Parterre Baiz and Zurkinden-Stube. Each has an arch-topped photo (#4–#7) and square bottoms.
- Events: Tapas Festival Kleinbasel, text-only and centered narrow, with #8 offset left.
- Newsletter, then the footer with the address.

Type: Anton uppercase for H1 and H2 only, in one weight. Familjen Grotesk 400/600 at 17px, line-height 1.55, 65ch. Expressive detail: the ß and Ü umlaut dots in the hero are set in var(--color-accent).

Images: Hard vertical crops at 3:4, full colour, filter: contrast(1.05). There are no rotations.

Detail: Hovering a room card raises its arch 4px, like a door easing open.

Avoid: overlays on photos, icon decorations, more than two filled buttons.
slop: Three equal columns of shadowed cards: the most common AI layout. Use an asymmetric or list-based layout instead.
report.critique:
1. **Hero headline is not the brief.** The H1 says "Herzlich Willkommen", which is generic welcome copy and the wrong word.
   - Replace it with "TORSTÜBLI", wrapping the Ü dots and the ß/Ü glyph detail in `<span class="dots">` with `color: var(--color-accent)`.
   - Set `.hero h1 { font-size: clamp(6rem, 18vw, 16rem); grid-column: 1 / -1; line-height: .85; }` so it runs edge to edge.
   - Delete `.hero-rule`. It is an extra decoration and a second accent use.
   - On 390px, 18vw ≈ 70px, below the 6rem floor. Use `clamp(4.5rem, 18vw, 16rem)` on mobile, or check that "TORSTÜBLI" at 96px (≈ 9 × 0.45em ≈ 390px+) does not overflow. It will, so lower the floor.

2. **Hero photo is in the wrong place.** Move `.hero-photo` out of the 4-column grid flow. Use `grid-column: 9 / 13; grid-row: 2; margin-bottom: -20vh;` so it sits under the full-width title on the right third.
   - Remove `box-shadow` from `.hero-photo img` and `.btn`.
   - Note: the source image is 1090×818 landscape cropped to 3:4. Set `object-position` deliberately on the façade or gate, not `center 40%`.

3. **Room cards fail the automatic finding** (shadowed equal cards in a grid).
   - Remove `.room`'s `background` gradient, `box-shadow`, `padding` and `border-radius`. Let the arch photo plus caption stand bare.
   - Stagger the grid asymmetrically: `.room-grid { grid-template-columns: 5fr 3fr 4fr 3fr; align-items: end; }` and `.room:nth-child(even) { margin-top: 96px; }`.
   - Change the hover to lift the whole arch: `.room:hover img { transform: translateY(-4px); }` is fine, but add `transition` to `.room img` only. That part is already correct.

4. **Section order and an invented section.** "Küche & Ambiente" is not in the brief's section list.
   - Move `#reservation` to directly after the strip, with text left and phone right as briefed.
   - Either drop the about section or fold one paragraph into the hero sub.
   - Remove "wir schaffen Genussmomente, die bleiben" and "Ein Ort, an dem … aufeinandertreffen" (a where-X-meets-Y tell) unless they are verified site copy.

5. **Invented copy to remove** unless it appears in the source:
   - "Wenn die Tage kürzer werden, kommt das Wild auf den Teller."
   - "Für das Dinner zu zweit ebenso wie für die grosse Runde – vier Räume, jeder mit eigenem Charakter."
   - "Bis bald in der Altstadt – herzlich, Ihr Gastgeber"
   - "Abende, an denen die Gläser mehr zu erzählen haben … heissen."
   - "Kleine Teller, grosse Runde – auch das Torstübli ist mit dabei."
   - "Für alle, die vom nächsten Wine & Dine … möchten."
   - "Ein paar Schritte vom Riehentor, mitten in der Altstadt."

6. **Events layout misses the brief**, which asks for text-only, narrow and centred with #8 offset left.
   - Set `.events-body { grid-column: 5 / 10; }` and `.events-photo { grid-column: 1 / 4; margin-top: 160px; }`.
   - Put Tapas Festival Kleinbasel first, since it is the briefed event.
   - Remove `border-radius` and `box-shadow` from `.events-photo img`. A second radius breaks the one-radius rule; use the arch or square.
